issue.title: Bug: Indent callback function

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

repository.name: eslint
repository.description: Find and fix problems in your JavaScript code.

issue.body:
**Eslint Version**
1.7.0

**Eslint configuration**

``` yaml
rules:
    indent:
        - 2
        - 4
        - SwitchCase: 1
```

**Source Code**

``` js
function example (callback) {
    callback();
}

example(
    function () {
        console.log('example');
    }
);
```

**Errors**

```
7:9  error  Expected indentation of 4 space characters but found 8  indent
8:5  error  Expected indentation of 0 space characters but found 4  indent
```

**Expected**
No Errors

**Note**
Eslint 1.6.0 does not print errors for this code.

body: +1 Behavior in 1.7.0 is not what I expect/want.

Another example:

What I had (which is fine)

```
    bridge.callHandler(
      'getAppVersion',
      null,
      function responseCallback(responseData) {
        window.ah.mobileAppVersion = responseData;  // line 65
      });  // line 66
```

What it seems to want (this is not what I expect)

```
    bridge.callHandler(
      'getAppVersion',
      null,
      function responseCallback(responseData) {
      window.ah.mobileAppVersion = responseData;  // line 65
    });  // line 66
```

I have `indent` configured with `[2, 2]`

```
  65:9  error  Expected indentation of 6 space characters but found 8  indent
  66:7  error  Expected indentation of 4 space characters but found 6  indent
```
Yeah, that looks like a bug.
I just hit this same bug, please fix and push an update. I'm disabling the `indent` rule for now in my repo.
Thanks @gyandeeps! We really appreciate the quick turnaround on bugfixes (it goes nicely with the rapid iteration on eslint 😍).
